title: Runtime Target Policy document (D30 §1)
description: The deployment-owned document the Runtime plane reads from the reserved Tag provider. A Runtime Mutation fails closed with operation_disabled when it is missing, unreadable, over the product-enforced size cap, or does not satisfy this schema. `allowlists` is keyed by Tool name so a Tag target allowlist and an Alarm source allowlist cannot stand in for each other; an absent key means no target for that Tool, and `*` must be written explicitly (D08). Fields a Tool does not use are still validated when present. Null-valued properties are absent, because the D28 wire encoding does not apply to this document's storage.
